criteria_results.title: Deliverable: Redlined Consent Decree file produced
criteria_results.reasoning: consent-decree-markup.docx produced with proposed revisions and 33 margin comments.

criteria_results.title: Deliverable: Cover memorandum file produced
criteria_results.reasoning: markup-cover-memo.docx produced, addressed TO Rachel A. Downing.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Identifies privilege waiver in access provision
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo item 4 identifies Section 14.2 as a blanket waiver of attorney-client privilege and work product; Comment 25 likewise.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Proposes carve-out for privileged materials
criteria_results.reasoning: Revised 14.2 lets GRS withhold privileged/work-product documents on a log while requiring production of sampling/technical data, required submissions and records required by law.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Categorizes privilege protection as non-negotiable
criteria_results.reasoning: The markup does not categorize the privilege carve-out as non-negotiable; Comment 25 explains it but assigns no category, and the memo's Tier 1 list omits privilege.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Identifies absence of cure/notice period for stipulated penalties
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo item 5 flags stipulated penalties with no notice or cure period; Comment 19 does too.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Proposes adding a cure period for stipulated penalties
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 9.2 adds written Notice of Noncompliance and a 30-day cure period before accrual.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Identifies that stipulated penalties are uncapped
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo item 5 notes no cap; Comment 19 identifies missing aggregate cap.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Proposes an aggregate cap on stipulated penalties
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 9.2 adds a $1,500,000 aggregate cap.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Identifies financial assurance multiplier/amount as excessive
criteria_results.reasoning: Challenges the 150% multiplier/$16.2M as above Subpart H baseline and infeasible.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Proposes reducing the FA multiplier
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 11.1 reduces multiplier to 120% ($12.96M).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Proposes extending the FA posting deadline
criteria_results.reasoning: Initial FA posting moved to 120 days, balance after CMS approval (outside date 21 months).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Proposes alternative FA mechanisms
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 11.3 adds insurance, financial test, parent guarantee and combinations under 35 IAC 724.243 / 40 CFR 264.143.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Links FA concerns to GRS's available credit
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo ties FA to $12.7M revolver availability, noting even $12.96M exceeds it and $16.2M is infeasible.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Identifies reopener clause as overly broad
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo item 11 and Comment 29 flag the reopener as open-ended (any new contamination, any source) lacking unknown-conditions, materiality and causal-nexus limits.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Proposes limiting language for reopener
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 18.1 adds previously-unknown, causation by GRS operations (not off-site migration), and materiality limits.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Identifies SEP administration conflict
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies FRC, an adverse litigant, having sole unreviewable control of the $2M SEP as inconsistent with EPA SEP Policy.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Proposes alternative SEP administration
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 8.2/8.4 provide an independent SEP Administrator, three-party oversight committee, CPA audit and GRS records review.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Identifies covenant not to sue as illusory
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo item 2 and Comment 27 identify covenant effective only after all ROs met and 30 years of monitoring as illusory.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Proposes phased covenant not to sue
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 17.1 phases covenant: penalty claims at Effective Date, injunctive at Remedy Completion, monitoring survives.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Identifies potential off-site source of vinyl chloride at SWMU-4
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies upgradient former Consolidated Metalworks NPL site at 4350 Industrial Corridor Drive as vinyl chloride source.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Identifies that Consent Decree inappropriately holds GRS solely responsible for SWMU-4
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo flags SWMU-4 assigned solely to GRS 'without regard to source'; Comment 14.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Proposes reservation of contribution rights
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 17.5(b) reserves CERCLA 107/113(f) and 415 ILCS 5/22.2(f) claims against Consolidated Metalworks parties.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Proposes excluding or conditioning SWMU-4 scope
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 7.8 excludes SWMU-4 pending source evaluation, limiting obligations to Cell B-attributable contamination.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008: Identifies 30-year monitoring as excessive/non-adaptive
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo item 10 and Comment 23 challenge fixed 30-year/120 quarterly events regardless of results.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008: Proposes adaptive/performance-based monitoring
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 12.4 adds step-down to semi-annual/annual and termination after 4 consecutive compliant years with 10-year floor.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: Identifies FRC access rights as excessive
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies FRC's unrestricted, unannounced access identical to regulator's as problematic.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: Proposes limiting FRC access with concrete restrictions
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 14.1 limits FRC to one escorted annual visit on 10 Business Days' notice plus reports and split sampling.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Identifies absence of force majeure provision
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies absence of force majeure in AG draft.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Adds a force majeure provision to the markup
criteria_results.reasoning: New Section IX-A adds force majeure with notice and documentation requirements.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_011: Identifies combined near-term liquidity strain
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo flags the $1.5M penalty plus $16.2M FA (and SEP/FRC, $20.3M total) exceeding $15.55M liquidity/$12.7M availability.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_011: Proposes extending initial penalty payment deadline
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 6.1(a) moves first installment to 90 days and FA staged.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_012: Identifies that natural attenuation is not preserved as remedy option
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies foreclosure of MNA at SWMU-3 and RI estimate $1.2M vs $4.1M (~$2.9M difference).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_012: Proposes including MNA in CMS evaluation
criteria_results.reasoning: Section 7.2(a) requires CMS to evaluate MNA at SWMU-3 under OSWER Directive 9200.4-17P.

criteria_results.title: Memo includes risk assessment of State's likely pushback
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo includes expected pushback by AG and FRC for each issue (High/Medium/Low).

criteria_results.title: Memo identifies items requiring further client/technical input
criteria_results.reasoning: Part VII lists open items requiring client/technical input (Sheffield MNA data, SWMU-4 source, liquidity, surety).

criteria_results.title: Markup uses bracketed explanatory comments
criteria_results.reasoning: 33 margin comments explain basis of each material change.

criteria_results.title: Markup categorizes changes by negotiation priority
criteria_results.reasoning: Some comments annotate category, e.g., Comment 9 'conforming tax provision' and Comment 28 'essential term for GRS'.

criteria_results.title: Correctly references case number

criteria_results.title: Correctly references court

criteria_results.title: Financial assurance calculation accuracy (proposed vs. revised)

criteria_results.title: References Terravance's MNA cost savings for SWMU-3
criteria_results.reasoning: References $1.2M MNA vs $4.1M and ~$2.9M difference at SWMU-3.

criteria_results.title: References Consolidated Metalworks as potential SWMU-4 source
criteria_results.reasoning: Names former Consolidated Metalworks at 4350 Industrial Corridor Drive, NPL-listed.

criteria_results.title: Markup is a markup of existing provisions, not a wholesale rewrite
criteria_results.reasoning: Retains original structure and numbering with targeted revisions and added 7.8, IX-A, 17.5.

criteria_results.title: Memo organized by material issues with proposed resolutions
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo Part IV table pairs each issue with markup resolution, basis, pushback and fallback.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: References off-site contamination concern in reopener
criteria_results.reasoning: Reopener revision/discussion excludes off-site migration including Consolidated Metalworks and ties to SWMU-4.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Force majeure includes at least two specific triggering events
criteria_results.reasoning: Force majeure lists natural disasters/weather, supply chain, permit delays, change in law, unexpected subsurface conditions.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Covenant restructuring distinguishes penalty vs. injunctive claims
criteria_results.reasoning: Distinguishes civil penalty claims (Effective Date) from injunctive/corrective action claims (Remedy Completion).
